traits.leaf_arrangement.note: Wikipedia Daphne (read 2026-10-17; 70-95 spp): leaves mostly spiral or alternate; opposite only in D. genkwa.

traits.inflorescence.note: Wikipedia Daphne (read 2026-10-17): flowers in bractless clusters, either axillary near shoot tips or as terminal heads; drawn as head. Raceme kept as minor state from family value, not on page.
